t:
It's all going great.

The undead from Men-Khatton don't give us much trouble. We have a real trading node here.

Gibberlings bring goods for transport to the New Land. Tiger and White orcs also deliver... whatchamacallit... The tribute... Yasak!

We do missionary work: we heal, teach, and share our faith in Tensess. And thanking our Mother for that.
Hello, hello! What brings you here to our frozen land? The call of duty?
Oh, is it for me? Thank you so much! Of course, I'll be there.

It's all going great.

I've seen Amanda recently. She's back from Umoir.

She and I, along with some old friends from the mysterious island, are preparing an expedition. But that's after the Great Ball, of course.

We want to check some theories about Isa and the Gibberlings.

Ton and I are waiting for someone else here.
Welcome back! I'm glad to see you! What brings you here?
It's quite unexpected to receive this from your hands. Thank you for the great honor.

Hmm. Not so bad.

After that one time, I've been supervising the local harbor, looking for smuggled and counterfeit goods. This is a crowded node, it keeps me pretty busy.

Siveria is slowly being populated, mainly by Gibberlings, but Kanian saltworkers, hunters, and woodcutters, also come here.

The nobility has been visiting us over the last year. They're plotting something. Mark my words.

I'll be happy to visit a big city and the Great Ball. I hear, they are going to grant amnesty to House de Doucer. I can't wait to see.
How interesting! Invitation to the Great Ball. From your own hands! It is a truly lucky day today.

We're still hunting the bandits in local forests and mountains.

We destroyed the biggest gangs ten years ago, with your help, but some petty bandits are left. We're hunting them down. We'd finish them, but the war is always in our way. You know, the demons, the architects...

Over the last year, the bandits have been receiving help from outside the allod. Someone brings smuggled weapons, puts in stashes on the shore, and quietly leaves. We don't have enough ships to patrol the whole place.

I'll set up a great manhunt after the Great Ball. The new gang, the Rats, are a pain in merchants' neck. I need to chase the rats down and execute them.
First and foremost, we are looking out for the League's best interests! We also look after the interests of elves and our own House.
An invitation? To the Great Ball? Are you joking? You're delivering it into my hands? I'm lost for words...

Same old, same old. Many thought that everything will go back to normal after the victory over the Castle's curse. However, the Kanian authorities doesn't seem to have resources for this place. The locals somehow manage to survive, but I'm telling you, they have a lot on their plate.

We have a problem with bandits in Valir. They have some hideouts in the thicket. And I suspect someone's been helping them over the past year. There's word on the street.

Settlement dwellers arrested several bandits and tortured some information out from them. Discontent nobility is supporting the bandits. Someone way more powerful is supporting the nobility. Rumor has it... should I tell you? Rumor has it, the Gray Prince is involved.

Thank you for passing the invitation. As a representative of the ruling House, I'm glad that you've been tasked with it. You're famous among my people. Not many can achieve so much over a short period of time.

On Tenebra?

Well... We're still dealing with the consequences of the dark emission from the Citadel. It has affected most living things on this allod.

We've lost our former Galleon Castle. Luckily, House de Ardeur could find another solution, but I can't discuss it yet.

We've learned how to handle the dark emission. Haven't we faced something similar on Nocturne?
This place sends shivers down my spine... The Tree... What is it? The essence of life?
This is the right ship! The ship to the Astral Atoll departs every two minutes from this pier. Don't miss your ship and watch out for the astral.
Wow! ! It's been a while! I didn't expect to see you again!

Receiving visitors!

Why? It's a comfortable location. Quiet, on the one hand. On the other hand, lots of ships pass by. I can get to Novograd if I need to.

Daniel and I are meeting someone here. We're going on an expedition, but we need to discuss everything first.

There's one thing I can tell you. It's Ferris. It's quarantined for now. The place is dangerous, with all these crazy Mechanoids and modificants.

But still. What is Ferris? We know for sure that this is the place where the Sculptor landed. Where was Ferris before the Cataclysm? Why does its fauna looks exactly like that of Howlem, which is a part of Isa? Are you getting my drift?

Do you want to join us? There's always room for you. I can't help but notice the change in you. When we first met on the mysterious island, who could have thought?
Ooh! How cute! Just look at this paper! And the cute lettering! You know, I've always dreamed to receive such invitation. Delivered by the elven celebrity in person! I'm happy.

I'm waiting for a friend of mine, Adele de Ardeur. She should be here in no time.

As for the House, we've left Tenebra a while ago. Not much to do here. Admire the desecrated masterpiece? Our Galleon Castle, that the disgusting vampires turned into the Citadel of Darkness? No way.

Our engineers left for our home allod Lumenara. They took up a new project. Do you want to know more? Patience! You'll see it soon.
Darkwater! What an uncivilized location. It smells like swamps and frogs. Pah!
We're happy to see the famous hero we heard so much about! Welcome to Irene, the glorious city of Ker-Is, to the royal court!
Al Rihat! I've been here before. There's no point in telling you about this city's history.

The elves are in touch with their motherland. The kingdom lost many of its subjects, but still captured imagination of every visitor. Irene was the abode of the most skilled people of craft. The goods were highly valued in all corners of the world. There's no saying about fine arts and culture! Artists, poets, sculptors, all of them created incredible masterpieces.

Several dynasties replaced one another over thousands of years. The Ollatars, the Vellunds, the Derniers, and many others.

Many elven Houses were blood relatives of the Royalty. Every House head recognized the suzerainty of the Irene kings. Many heads of Houses received noble titles as a token of appreciation of their merit to the throne. The noble titles were proudly worn by House members and passed down in generations.

The tradition existed before the Cataclysm.

The great feasts, where every House sought to overcome, transcend, and impress everyone.

In the beginning, the Conclave used the occasion to solve their issues. It was an honor to become a student of a Great Mage, especially the one that had lived before the Cataclysm. Soon, they began bringing other comprehensive issues to everyone's attention.

Everything was ruined after the Cataclysm. Many elves died. Those who survived under the Great Mages' protection, couldn't meet their kin from other allods.

The Irene allod survived. The last king had an artifact, the Key of Creation, given to him by the Conclave. The power of the Key was enough to support an allod.

Soon, a tragedy happened. The Key was stolen, and Irene disappeared into the astral. Grallon, the last king, used a portal to move himself and a handful of subjects to the Yoggor allod, supported by the king's distant relative, the Great Mage Gramon de Doucer.

Grallon was very old by that time. He didn't live long after that. Many claimed him as their blood relative. House de Desirae, the House of Grallon's wife, was one of them. But Gramon de Doucer took another decision. He restored the tradition of the Great Balls.

It wasn't visited much in the beginning. After a while, elves learned to create cheap and stable portals. The Great Balls attracted many participants. The old era was kicking in.

The leader was chosen in a competition. A queen's relative, the Great Mage Margo de Desirae, strongly objected. She declared herself the new queen of elves. From that moment, the House that won the Great Ball was considered the ruling House of elves.

You shall meet King Louis de Desirae, son of Margo and father of Prince Dakkar. After the victory in the year 990, House de Desirae defines the elven politics. Everything will change soon.

You need to appear before the king.

Take the gondola at the pier, and it'll take you there in no time. I could take you there, but Irene's legislation states that all visitors must come through the harbor. Let's not break the rules, shall we? Show your invitation to the Pier Keeper, and go. I'll go ahead to introduce you to the king.

I'll see you on Irene.
The invitation to the Great Ball, of course. I need to see the invitation to take you to Irene. Come back when you have one. You can always find me right here.

Allow me to greet you on behalf of all elves.

Do you have the invitation?

I must look up the list of visitors. It'll take a minute.

Everything is great,. Welcome aboard.
The show begins soon! I need to pull myself together. The future depends on me.
What, don't you know me? I feel uncomfortable, don't really know what to do around here... Let's go grab a quick bite? I don't want to approach the tables on my own!
Huh? Fine, fine... I'm having a good time so far! There is Caspar and Murk...
Look who remembered an old friend...
Yes, they did... Why should I be happy? You're always off on adventures, and I'm alone and forgotten.
Some of us still have to work...

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 305, House de Desirae wins, Great Mage Margot de Desirae writes "Dialogues on Service", substantiating a point of view that explains why elves should educate lower races and have them serve elves. Those who are resistant to training (humans in particular) should be avoided.

Year 319, House de Blizare wins. Great Mage Bernard de Blizare creates "The Treatise on the Essence of the Astral", with a theoretical substantiation of the existence of the Astral.

Year 335, House de Grandeur wins, Vincent de Grandeur creates "The Book of Astral Curses" which summarizes all known spells associated with the astral.

Year 364, House de Delice wins. Ervier de Delice invents a stable stationary portal between the allods that allows you to travel in a relatively simple way, albeit with a colossal expenditure of magical energy.

Year 384, House de Desirae wins. Viola di Desirae writes "Odes of Love", a collection of the greatest elven love lyrics.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 404, House de Delice wins. Florian de Delice finds a solution to the dispute between the elven Houses and settles the conflict over territory.

Year 419, House de Doucer wins, Renalda de Doucer restores the list of ancient elven spells found on Yoggor.

Year 443, House de Delice wins/ Florian de Delice solves the problem of settling the status of the Small elven Houses.

Year 464, House de Pluie wins. Thibault de Pluie creates an economic treatise on trade, banks and auctions.

Year 479, House de Ardeur wins, Gaben de Ardeur makes a breakthrough in the study of the properties of June crystals.

Year 499, House de Pluie wins, Gracienna de Pluie creates a unique piece of jewelry - the Diadem of Drops.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 515, House de Blizare wins, Justine de Blizare completes a study on the influence of the astral on the flora and fauna of allods.

Year 538, House de Vevre wins. Majel de Vevre writes an opera about Irene, one of the greatest works in the genre.

Year 556, House de Grandeur wins, Neven de Grandeur writes a work on the history of magic from the founding of the elven kingdom to the present day.

Year 583, House de Desirae wins, Rival de Desirae creates a ten-ingredient salad recipe.

Year 596, House de Delice wins. Denise de Delice paints one of the most beautiful paintings in history - The Birth of Beauty, depicting the awakening of the first elves.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 620, House de Douceur wins, Great Mage Gramont de Douceur creates a deadly spell that can annihilate an entire allod.

Year 639, House de Pluie wins, Gerard de Pluie creates a treatise "On the Enjoyment of Life".

Year 658, House de Vevre wins. Perpetua de Vevre creates a collection of works by the inhabitants of the allods, "Tales and Other Fables".

Year 676, House de Blizare wins, Fabiola de Blizare discovers a new healing principle that significantly accelerates tissue regeneration.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 707, House de Vevre wins. Great Mage Catherine de Vevre negotiates with Tensess, which culminates in the creation of the League.

Year 724, House de Ardeur wins, Lienar de Ardeur creates holographic illusions.

Year 741, House de Grandeur wins, Baudouin de Grandeur discovers new principles of the art of summoning elementals.

Year 762, House de Pluie wins, Guillaume de Pluie concludes a new trade agreement between the elves and Kania.

Year 779, House de Doucer wins, Great Mage Gramont de Doucer founds a magic academy on Yoggor which has now been transferred to the Stellara allod.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 800, House de Grandeur win. Albert de Grandeur will settle the conflict between the Kanians and Gibberlings, then enter into an alliance with them. The Gibberlings receive the Lightwood allod in exchange for the secret of astral flights.

Year 823, House de Ardeur wins, Raymond de Ardeur creates the prototype of the first astral ship.

Year 845, House de Blizare wins, Maximilien de Blizare invents a new potion that greatly speeds up reactions.

Year 864, House de Pluie wins. Guillaume de Pluie formulates the principles of cultural expansion, which should transform other civilizations, passing to them the ideals of the elves. Elves finally step out of isolation.

Year 884, House de Vevre wins. Caspar de Vevre writes the Triumph of Beauty symphony, one of the greatest works of the elves.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 901, House de Doucer wins. Umbert de Doucer comes up with a plan of attack on the Kirah allod and starts a new war with the Empire. Astral ships will be used in this war.

Year 924, House de Blizare wins. After repelling an attack of astral demons, Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare writes a military work about their vulnerabilities and the ways of dealing with them. In the future, this information becomes the basis for the creation of the Order of Demon Hunters.

Year 937, House de Grandeur wins, Estelle di Grander predicts the future. Recorded, her predictions become known as Estelle's Quatrains. The Conclave decides to classify some of the information they contain. Estelle's prophecies rehabilitate the elven Oracles who are now free to practice.

Year 962, House de Ardeur wins. Raymond de Ardeur and his student Celestina de Ardeur solve the mystery of the Imperial astral energy and improve its principles.

Year 990, House de Desirae wins, Dakkar de Desirae demonstrates extraordinary skills in the field of necromancy. From that moment on, the Conclave finally lifts the prohibitions on necromancy.

We're preparing a speech for the trial! As the main participant and witness of almost all the events, you will also have to testify!

Don't worry, it's simple. Only Renard is against us, the rest of the Heads of Houses are rather neutral. We can win them over!

Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit... inconvenient details.

Shall we begin?

Of course! The vampires of Amarantha hoped we would be able to make the Heads of the Houses change their mind. At least now they can count on the help of the elves. Perhaps the rest of Sarnaut's vampires will join me soon.
I understand why Antoinette relied on diplomacy. The main milestones in the history of the elves are associated with the formation of alliances and the resolution of various disputes.

This is very touching! You managed to make a major contribution to our victory, and the fact that you voted for me... My gratitude will be eternal. If you need something, Ignis will always welcome you.

Oh, it won't be an easy choice... There are so many interesting things. I would even support Renard, but, alas, this is not in our political interests. Perhaps Guillaume? They used to paint me, too... There is "Naked Truth"... It hangs in the palace of a certain ruler, behind a curtain. Hmm! I will probably support Caspar de Vevre, his idea of the ensemble is exactly what I want myself! It's decided. House de Vevre!
I see you understand the importance of magic! It's the essence of our world. And while we didn't win today, you made the right choice. Someday we'll win.

I want science to win this competition! So Maximilien, I guess? Though Antoinette's idea is very tempting. The world... gives scope for scientific exchange of ideas. Although, if you think about it... It's decided: House de Blizare!
Did we win you over with our concert? I knew it! Admit it, it's marvelous when different voices sing in unison! My House... did a lot of harm in its time. Perhaps I can atone... Perhaps...

I was quite impressed by this trial... And the vampires' sacrifice! I already started composing a new symphony, or rather, an opera about the tragic story of their fate! I liked a lot of things: Galleon Castle, Guillaume's painting... But I'll probably support Antoinette. It's decided. House de Delice!
Bravo! We wouldn't have done this without you. Your help on Umoir, and now here... I don't know how to thank you! I think I will admire you the way Ivetta does it!
Oh, you appreciated my masterpiece! I believe it's a sure sign that you know your art! There aren't a lot of us artists, but we all support each other.

Impressive, isn't it?

True art does not need fanfares, so I didn't try to draw too much attention to my masterpiece. All these performances are nothing but pointless bustle, but this is something to remember!

I haven't decided yet.

Caspar's symphony is a great accomplishment. But if we talk about creations, it pales in comparison with everything that surrounds us. I'm talking about Galleon Castle, of course.  It's decided. House de Ardeur!

The operation was executed perfectly! We achieved the expected result. Unfortunately, good news comes with bad news. Hmm... Orcs. We seem to be having a problem on one of our allods. Another delusional prophet shaman... He went into the desert and ate cacti, and now he's confusing minds with his appeals. I guess I'll have to leave Irene soon.
Antoinette's victory is what we wanted. However, remember that elves are deceitful. Do not believe a single word she says. She can undermine your faith in our ideals and leaders!

Unfortunately, House de Ardeur did not win. However, I would not declare mourning yet. Antoinette is not going to leave the League tomorrow, and peace... Well, we have already made peace. There is still something to talk about, what we can offer. We will discuss the situation at the Council of Governors. Besides, I'm told the Empire has its own problems.
To be honest, I look at this and see that it's all about women! Antoinette has enough daughters to seduce a whole regiment. They confuse and tempt everyone around!

House de Ardeur!

If we elect them, we will get an era of scientific progress combined with religious fervor. A war with the Empire awaits - most likely a long but victorious one. Light will illuminate the most distant corners of this world, changing it forever!

Is this your final decision?

House de Blizare!

If we elect them, we will give a powerful boost to the development of magic and alchemy. Where will these efforts lead us? Perhaps the Demon Hunters will bring about changes that will make the elves better? Turn them into something else?

Is this your final decision?

You've made your choice! Celestine will take it into account when counting the votes. Whatever the result, remember that your vote is just a drop in the ocean, even if weighty.

Now go and upload the votes you've collected to Celestine.
We are flattered, but let us remind you that this year Our House cannot be elected, therefore We advise you to choose another House.

House de Delice!

If we elect them, we will begin a new era of peace and prosperity. We will make peace with the Empire, launch joint and grandiose construction projects... We'll be united by common goals... Interpenetration of cultures will begin... What do they call it on Igsh? Convergence? Will this peace lead to something new? Or will we drift apart again? Only time will tell.

Is this your final decision?

House de Grandeur!

If we elect them, we will return to the old days when elves relied entirely on magic. Old curses and ancient spells will return. I think the elves will abandon all these technologies in favor of magic... They will walk a different path, going back to closed borders and impregnable allods, protected by the power of their Great Mages.

Is this your final decision?

House de Pluie!

If we elect them, we will enter an era of free trade. Its volume will grow every year, and our allods will become the manufacturers of the most amazing things for the rest of Sarnaut. By selling and buying, lending and holding money, we will dominate the world - not by force of arms or the power of magic, but with the help of finance...

Is this your final decision?

Of course. There is no rush, but please remember that thousands of elves throughout Sarnaut are now waiting for the final vote. And not only elves, because changes in our society will affect everyone who is involved in world politics...

So which House will you support, ?

House de Vevre!

If we elect them, we will spread our cultural influence throughout Sarnaut. We will master all the new technologies of the Empire, and we will surpass and improve them. Their "motion pictures" will serve as evidence of our way of life, and gramophones will play enchanting music.

Is this your final decision?

It is undoubtedly a difficult decision to make, !

Renard de Ardeur has done a lot. His Galleon Castle is a true miracle, the best creation of my people. Something we've worked towards and dreamed about when we saw the endless seas of the astral. He managed to accomplish everything he wanted.

Antoinette de Delice has also achieved a great deal. Her diplomatic efforts have brought the exiled children back into the fold of my people, and now she will endeavor to make a lasting and permanent peace with the Empire. But this enmity is thousands of years old. How many lives will be saved if she succeeds? But it was rightly said that every life is equally important, be it yours or that of this Orc Psionicist...

And you're about to make your own choice! As for me... It's decided. House de Delice!
I understand. My potions made an impression. Perhaps you'd like to do more tests? We could make you stronger and faster! Think about it when you have time.

The time for alchemy will come, I'm sure. We are not only making aphrodisiacs, we are now entering completely new spheres of knowledge! Explosives, elixirs that change the essence of the one who takes them! With time, we can change the world!

It's a difficult choice...

Albert and Baudouin impressed me with that archer. What if we give her explosive arrows? And experiment with different compounds that can make her stronger?

Though Galleon Castle is a true miracle. It's a unique achievement.  Although... It's decided. House de Grandeur!

We were so close to victory! The thing is, if this Ball had taken place ten years ago, we would have won... The Galleon is still magnificent, but it's yesterday's news. Perhaps we should think of something new? We could continue developing the Galleon Castle's AI. She can't do much right now, but with time she might evolve into something greater.

Ah, I see you're resorted to discrediting tactics? I have to admit, I'm impressed... I wonder how you figured that out, I could swear I left no evidence!

Well done ! You are becoming an expert in espionage. As for Marion: firstly, I deny everything, and secondly, you yourself said at the trial that vampires are not to blame. It's all Armando's fault. Thirdly, she's too good a lover.
I hope no one expects us to abandon our plans even if Antoinette wins?
We will win next time. And then...

I've seen a lot of beautiful but largely impractical things.

A painting? Lovely, but we have plenty of those. All palaces are covered with pictures of naked maidens and steamy scenes! A concert? I'm sorry, but I'm not a fan of ethnic music. I prefer opera. An alliance with vampires? Don't make me laugh.

So only the statue and potion remain. Both can be useful in times of war. I must decide what's more useful.

Although, Marianne here enjoyed both the music and the painting. Fine, I'll support the creator. It's decided. House de Pluie!
You already have a companion: Triss. Look for her calling card in your bag!

Considering all your accomplishments and certain circumstances... Yes, there's someone who can't wait to explore everything around here. Her interests seem to align with yours. She has managed to wear us all out, I hope you'll help her channel her energy into something productive. If this is agreeable to you, I believe she'll be ready in no time. So what do you say? Does it suit you?
I don't think we are ready for this. Every member of our House is important to us, and you have yet to prove your reputability and earn our trust.
That's great. I hope we'll have fun together!

Then here's her calling card. You have probably seen these already – all Houses on Irene use them. Special magic will allow your companion to instantly teleport to you anywhere on Irene – just take it in your hands and read the name on it! If you read the name again, your companion will return to the residence!
It looks like you already have a companion from another House. If you want to part with them, then it's alright. Otherwise it's impossible – we value our House's prestige above all!
Even considering your merits, I don't think this is the right time. Our relations with your current patron House are far from good.
You already have Rosan from our House with you.

Hmm... Yes, it's possible. Actually, it would be a good thing! There is... an interesting young man. We are proud of people like him – young geniuses, but he could certainly benefit from being more... sociable. A member of a Great House should be recognized in social circles! He has a lot of respect for you, so you are probably our only chance to get him to take a walk around Irene. Are you interested?
I'm afraid not. You have yet to prove your trustworthiness to our House.

Yes, this is his calling card. Everyone uses them on Irene, even other Houses. As soon as you read the name on it, he will immediately appear next to you. If you read it again, the companion will leave you.
It looks like you already have a companion from another House. If you are willing to part with them, it will please us!
We trust you, but we're not so sure about your patrons. We suggest you change them before asking about something like that.
You already have Lea de Desirae with you.
Perhaps it can be arranged. One of the members of our House has always wanted to explore Irene in the company of a true hero, but she is quite... timid herself.
I'm afraid you have yet to prove your trustworthiness in the eyes of the king and our House.
I can't blame you. Here, this is Lea's calling card. Be kind to her.
That's great. Here's her calling card. Just read the name on it, and Lea will instantly teleport to you in any part of Irene. Read it again, and she will return to us. Have a good time!
We heard you already have a companion from another House. Are you willing to part with them?
As a ruling House, we cannot allow this as long as you have one of our rivals as your patron.
It's so beautiful here, isn't it?
You already have Lier with you!

What a wonderful idea! You'll get an excellent companion, and we'll strengthen our authority. Which is why one of the best representatives of our House will go with you: Lier de Delice. Everyone adores him!
I'm afraid our House does not know you well enough.
I hope they won't be upset. Here, the calling card of our handsome diplomat, Lier de Delice!

Exactly. I believe you'll like him, too. Here, take his calling card. As soon as you read the name on it, he will immediately appear next to you. Use the calling card again, and the companion will understand that it's time for them to leave. Good luck!
I've been informed you already have a companion. Do you wish to part with them?
Oh, we have nothing against you personally, but your patron House... It won't do.
You already have Grim de Grandeur with you.
Yes, there's a young man. I'm sure his bold ideas... Will be to your liking. He's a little arrogant, but your authority is unquestionable.
I'm sorry, but we doubt the sincerity of your respect for us and for magic.
That's a correct decision. Our best innovator will gladly join you. Here is his calling card, and we'll get rid of the old one...

Here's the calling card. It's enchanted: just read his name, and he will teleport to you. To make the companion return to the residence, just read his name on the calling card again. Only within Irene's borders, of course.
As far as we know, you already have a companion from another House. Are you ready to part with them?
You share our values, but the same cannot be said about your patron House.
Unless our information is outdated, you already have Elia with you.

We believe it will be a mutually beneficial commitment. There is a young woman with an astute business sense who is looking for some company. She believes a joint exploration of Irene will help her develop her communication skills. Are you interested?
Alas, it's impossible at this time. We are not sure we can trust you yet.
That's reasonable. This is our young entrepreneur, Elia. She'll be happy to join you. Here's her calling card.
I'm glad to hear that. Here's her calling card. Do you know how to use it? You read the name on it, and the companion instantly teleports to you. You read it again, and the companion goes away.
Unless our information is outdated, you already have a companion from another House. Are you ready to part with them?
No, it's not beneficial for us. Considering who your patron House is, it will only bring harm to our reputation.

If you build a good reputation with one of the great Houses, they will be happy to allow a member of the House to travel with you as your companion on Irene. Not only will it let you spend time in pleasant company, you will also gain bonus reputation with the House your companion belongs to. Of course, no House will provide a companion for you if your patron House is their rival.

You can discuss the possibility with any quartermaster of a House.
You already have Aquila from our House with you.
What an interesting and timely desire! Yes, the best member of our House has been dreaming of exploring Irene with you! Take her with you!
It’s not the time. Show us that your love for music is as strong as our own!
Magnificent! We can finally get a good companion for Aquila!
Here's her magic calling card. Just read the name on it, and she will immediately join you! Use the calling card again, and the companion will understand that it's time for them to leave.
We heard you already have a companion from another House. Are you ready to part with them?
It looks like you have entrusted yourself to the patronage of a wrong House. You need to choose another Patron House!

Oh Great Ball, the kingdom of beauty and luxury. For me and you, a lot of work, too. Just look around! All of them wish to change their appearance before the Ball.

I am the Master of Changes. I can make you look completely different. I bring changes into your life, whether it's just hairstyle, hair color, physique, or gender. I can go even further! My thorough knowledge of magic and physiology will allow me to change your race!

It will cost you a few more Carnival Masks. The number depends on how profound the changes will be.

So, have you made up your mind?
So many new faces! Many of them look unfamiliar, but who knows, whose soul is hiding behind the mask?

Can you imagine what the Ball of Seven Houses is like? It's quite a spectacle! A storm of emotions! And passion! A competition in style, elegance, and originality! And I, Antoine de Ardeur, will do my best to steal the scene. I want to put on a costume show! To stage a battle between the League and the Empire. Of course, the preparations took longer than I expected. The thing is, during the show, our actors become overwhelmed with passion! Not every costume can survive that, you understand! I had to look for replacements! But now I'm ready to show the result!
Let's welcome our important guest! Perhaps you need a costume? I'll be glad to be of assistance!
Just a modest couturier from Novograd! Of course, some say I'm the best couturier in the world! And... I believe they are right.

Cooking, of course. I'm a cook after all! There can't be a Great Ball without a great feast! So we're cooking day and night! And this time it's not just the elves we need to please - but also humans, Gibberlings, and even Orcs!
Greetings! What brings you to Irene?
Formerly a prisoner of the Empire, and now a common cook here on Irene. Why are you so curious? You have to admit, you can't have a proper Ball without a feast!

Really? Weird. This is a minor House. However, we're pretty famous. We served the Great Mage Pascal in the dukedom of Mebir! My noble ancestor was the butler in Mebir tower! Alas, we had to run away after the Cataclysm. We found shelter at the allod Malar. We have to preserve our etiquette skills in the society of savage Kanians... it isn't easy, but somebody's got to do it. I've been told that the guests undergo etiquette training here. Let's see if the training complies with the ancient elven traditions! We can't allow to distort our traditions!
Oh, what joy, what beauty! Just look around you! It's like in the good old times!

Bruno de Amfas, at your service. I represent House de Amfas at the Great Ball. Royal etiquette and traditions are my specialty. I've always dreamed of coming here, and now I have this opportunity! Who could have thought that Irene would be found and chosen as the Great Ball site! Look how well this place has been restored! As if it hadn't been ten centuries!

The glory of our House has long gone. Our House used to be rich, prosperous, and famous. Alas, time takes its toll. We lost too much during the Night of Astral Portals, when the Ark allod was destroyed and the Great Mage Erast died. But we remain optimistic. We grant shelter to Sarnaut travelers. You can see our residences in all corners of the world.
Greetings! Oh, the charming antiquity! Irene is amazing, isn't it?

I'm Colette de Ark, a herbalist. You might think, what a weird profession for an elven lady. Sometimes life leaves you no choice. I'm staying in a stronghold of one of the guilds, helping them cure local peasants.

Unforgivable ignorance. House de Avale is a glorious house, although it's not one of the Great Houses. Our abode is the Florenta allod. One of the Great Houses gave us shelter. We're few, but we're united. Our profession is pet training. You know, cats, dogs, and the like. Everyone's crazy about them. I think that taming a real Irene fairy would be a real challenge. Not just anyone with a basket of berries, but a truly beautiful fairy. The one that can be found only on Irene.
Oh, Irene! The motherland of magic fairies! I'm dreaming to find them!

I'm Linda de Avale. Haven't you heard the legend? These creatures were made by the most powerful Mages of the first Conclave. They needed someone to test their elf-transforming spells on. Over time, fairies spread all over the world, but only here, on Irene, you can find the primal fairies that remember the names of their creators. I want to have them as servants in my House.

House de Craner was a source for the royal army of the Velund dynasty! I have to admit, we're in decay now. Alas, the true masters of sword aren't valued among elves today. They prefer magic! Or rather, preferred - until recently. When the war with the Empire began, many elves decided that a good sword, especially enchanted, does a better job than an ice comet or a fireball! That's when our skills came in handy. My House has opened a fencing school in Lightwood. Among our students there are elves, Kanians, and even Gibberlings.
You there! Hello! Would you like to cross swords with me? I don't insist, but just in case.

I'm Conrad de Craner, a noble representative of my ancient House. You must have heard about me. I performed numerous feats in my life. But my dream is to fight in a duel with a true master of sword! I hear there is such master on Irene. Bussy de Tristesse, a fencer who has never been defeated. I might throw a glove.

The thing is, all the events, which Zayan describes in his latest work about the recent past, are all made up. None of it happened in reality. In fact, Nihaz never locked up Sarn. On the contrary, Sarn locked up Nihaz. He chained him to a rock for giving people the gift of magic.

I carefully analyzed his work and found a number of inconsistencies. Here's my version: in fact, Sarn is an evil tyrant, obsessed with spreading the Light, wanting to control everything. Only the Dark God Nihaz can do good to Sarnaut. All he ever wanted is for us to progress and develop. Nihaz can give us knowledge that will make us gods!

Ah! Mirages. Nothing but mirages, created by Cosmos, Sarn's evil minion. He used the Observatory and with the help of the traitor Klavdia created an illusion of the future, where Nihaz allegedly "destroyed" the world. If you think about it, this is just stupid. No idea why Nihaz might need this. Wasn't he trying to explain to you how this world works? Didn't he help you fight the insane cultists of Sarn? You shouldn't believe Cosmos or anything he shows you in his so-called "Observatory".
Oh, hey, I know you. You're Zayan's acolyte. He constructs his dubious historical theories based on your deeds and visions.

Well, all historians are his students, in a sense. Just like my good friend Roxane, the head of our House, I belong to those who avoided the fate of turning into a vampire and escaped in a shelter on Nea. Zayan is wise, but he's mistaken. None of it really happened.
I'm just vacationing here! It's nice to know there's a place where you can rest from never-ending military service. Will there ever be a time without war?
Greetings! It's nice and peaceful here on Irene! Quite a nice change of pace from war...
Magister of the League Defenders! I fought on Asee-Teph and in other battles. Which ones? I'm sorry, I can't tell you that.
I'm here for the sole purpose of having fun... Intrigues? War? Let's forget about that for the time being and relax here on Irene.

Felix de Grandeur, the trainer of all mages in Novograd, at your service! My House appreciates magic in all its forms, so it's not surprising that I became the one who teaches all the young mages of the League on the Kanian Archipelago.

Our House is known for popularizing our philosophy and formula in life: "everything for pleasure." We're the most famous hedonists and people of leisure in Sarnaut. We strive to achieve as many pleasures in life as we can. We're always busy lounging in our hidden shelter on Ellanash allod. We taste delicate food, listen to elegant music, study the most elaborate erotic practices...
Good afternoon! Where can I... where can I find the Rose and Hibiscus? Although... you don't know, of course. Why would you?

Jessica de Fore, at your service. I arrived at Irene to satisfy my passion to exquisite pleasures. It is widely known that there's no other place like the Rose and Hibiscus! Alas, I heard, it's not to easy to get inside. I'm looking for an opportunity to visit.

Oh! Haven't you heard about our House? It is no equal to the Great Houses, of course, but it used to shine back in the day. Members of my House were permanent members of the Dernier royal dynasty entourage back in the day when Irene was a kingdom. We lived a carefree life, without worries, without thinking of the future... and then the Cataclysm struck. Not many were saved. We were scattered on different allods. We reunited just recently under the shelter of the glorious House de Ardeur on the allod Lumenara.
I would love for the Great Ball to start! I can't wait to dance!

My name is Jennifer de Gloire. I represent the minor House, but my true goal is to dance at the Great Ball. I know that preparations take time, but I just can't wait for it to start. Oh, the dance! The pinnacle of elven grace! What can be more beautiful than unite in harmony with other elves?

What a question! Look around you, and you'll get your answer. I'm the owner of a fair number of newspapers and magazines, including a few spicy ones. Compared to them, Sharp Ears would be a Trinity Church leaflet about the principles of the moral code of an Imperial citizen, trust me! I brought my hottest girls with me... Alas, my birds have flitted away, or else I would've introduced you. Well, you are probably busy anyway, right? So am I! I won't keep you, it was nice to finally meet you face to face!
Oh my, look who is here!
Ha ha! Don't you recognize me? We haven't met, of course, but you know quite a few of my colleagues. You are looking at another member of the famous Tycoon Club. Not the last one, I'm sure.

Oh, House de Conte! We're eternal travelers, wandering minstrels, roaming around Sarnaut and telling stories. We were like this centuries ago. We'll be like this in centuries to come. We do have a residence. We return to Stellar, under the cover of the eternal and endlessly wise night. We exchange the things we learned along the way, record our songs, and come up with new ballads.
Harmony de Conte, traveling minstrel, at your service!

Yes, we have! In Cosmos Observatory, in the lair of the blind demon Cairage... But I can't tell for sure if I saw you or some other hero. The Observatory is a weird place. It's like a room full of mirrors, with unique reflections in each of them. As far as I know, Cairage was dealt with in our world.
Can't you see? I'm standing here. Thinking. About life. You know, my House is far from perfect. Perhaps you've heard about its accomplishments? Then you understand...
How much did you drink? Tell me! Or is that you fooling around?

Phew! No way. Who hasn't heard about House de Luner? Oh well... Not many, I guess. That's because we're hiding from everyone on Nocturne. We're interested in collecting the most shocking secrets of Sarnaut! Did you know that Yasker and Rysina were lovers? Oh, come on, the word is on the street! How about this: Catherina is Aidenus's daughter! Amazing, right? And she was pregnant... from Sarn! Cool, huh? Wait, don't go! I can tell you about Zayan and Klavdia! Don't you want to know?
Psst! Hush! Walls have ears! Keep your voice down!

I'm Imelda de Luner. I'm... not afraid. Of anything. It's just... You know. It's Irene, right? It's swarming with spies... and plots... and conspiracies... Haven't you heard the story of the Great Ball? Everyone wants to win the Great Game. And the easiest way is to spy on your opponents! Find out about their plans! I overheard many... you know, many curious things. Did you know that the so-called artists stopped on Florenta allod on the way? I don't trust them. They're not who they say they are. I'm sure they're... cultists!

Uh, haven't you heard? But oh well. We're madly famous. Although, sadly, we're not a Great House. We live on the allod Tempesta under the protection of House de Pluie, but nothing can falter our honor! You can track our House's history back to the times when Ollatars ruled the Irene allod. House de Mork was famous for its loyalty to the throne. Many daughters of our House became queens, and noble knights took positions of majordomos, councilors, and marshals. No one dares to offend the name of my House and get away with it.
Do you know where I can find the elf Giacomo de Vevre?

My name is Geronimo de Mork. The filthy scum gravely offended me! The thing is... that my fiancée... Julia... Well, she's a little carefree. The bastard abused her naive vulnerability, fed her a pack of lies, and seduced her. I caught them naked in bed! Just as I grabbed my sword, the bastard jumped out of the window and ran away. I'll beat the crap out of him, I swear! Just let me find him. He'll know better than to seduce girls!

I'm watching history unfold! I'm wondering what our wards think of the recent developments. I'm talking about minor races, of course. Aviaks, Harpies, Lamias... They have their rights, too, you know! And we often forget how difficult their life is...
Oh, a familiar face! I wonder where I've seen you before. I know you...

Oh! I'm a historian! Like many of us, we couldn't miss this event. Zayan himself is here. Of course, we have much to do... For the past few years, they keep bringing new things to our allod Nea. Unfortunately, we have no time to sort through that.

I told you - I'm resting! You think it's easy keeping watch over the portal all day long? I had to step away a few times - there was once a conference on portalology issues... Anyway, it doesn't matter! I left an excellent illusion on the Kanian Archipelago - no one would notice.
Hey, hey. Quiet! Since you've recognized me, you understand why I have to keep a low profile.
So you don't recognize me after all? Alright! I'm Hugues de Delice, the main portal keeper of Novograd. I control the portal in Aidenus' Tower. I decided to take some time off and visit this allod.

I came to support my House... No, not in the Great Game - thankfully we don't participate this time. Considering what happened the last time, they could probably use my help. Especially since the best summoners of our House are currently working with the prince...

I am the trainer of all summoners on the Kanian Archipelago... I've been doing this for several decades - ever since Prince Dakkar won the Great Ball and the Church gave us permission to train new demonologists...

It isn't special. We've always been blocked out by more famous and glorious Houses. After the Cataclysm, we ended up on Yoggor. My House served House de Doucer for a long while, but after old Gramon died, and his heir Armando committed the notorious crime, we were forced to change sides. Nocturne is Yoggor's new name. After the eclipse, it belongs to House de Desirae. We're their loyal servants. Just the same as we were to our previous lords.
Good afternoon! I'm glad to see so many new faces on Irene.

Wilhelmina de Roche. Nice to meet you. It's so good to be on Irene! Let me tell you more about myself. I'm the tutor of Prince Dakkar's children, Antoine and Julie de Desirae. Or Anton and Julia Valir if you use their mother's name. They stayed with their mother, so I had the chance to visit the Great Ball and make my dream come true. I miss my students, but I'm sure they'll be better off on Nocturne than in the busy palace of their grandfather. Although these kids surely know how to keep everyone busy.

My House is just a minor House you have probably never heard of. We live on the Gelida allod, by the grace of the reigning House de Blizare. Gelida is a harsh place, where winter lasts forever. But the forests are full of animals, and rivers and lakes are full of fish. The mission of my House is to provide food for everyone. Trade alone can't cover all our needs.
Hey-ho! Welcome to the blessed allod!

I'm Domingo de Ruse, friend! I'm a great hunter. I arrived here because a Royal Hunt was promised to me. Have you heard of it? How come? Let me tell you. There is a tradition: they organize a Royal Hunt after every Great Ball. There's a great location for hunt, the Egladien Forest, full of all kinds of game. Just imagine how we seek, chase, and kill the prey... and how it will be running away from the hunt in panic!
It's nice to see you here, Stormbringer!
I'm a student of Orpheus's! I was invited here, and it's a pleasure to see so many familiar faces.

Isn't it obvious? I write sonnets! Oh, gone are the days when my faithful lute and I wandered the roads, discovered new things, went on adventures, met famous heroes... But I must say, life in Novograd is quite exciting... And I have Irene to entertain me - it's a place I'm always happy to visit whenever I'm invited!
I'm happy to see you here among the elven people!
Allow me to introduce myself. Charles de Vevre, a famous bard and the trainer of all bards in Novograd.

Irene in general and Egladien in particular are a nature reserve full of rare plants. Many species were lost after the Cataclysm, but it turned out they still grow here! Royal Leaf, for example! Or Trifle Herb! I collect samples that I will later move to the greenhouse. Field work is what I've dreamed of since they got me out of that Irdrich sarcophagus. Imagine waking up with a bunch of wires connected to your every orifice!
What are you doing in this forest?
I'm a herbologist. I study various living creatures, primarily herbs...
I make new deals, of course! Wood from Umoir is gaining in price, but copper from Suslanger mines is going down... There's so much to do!
I'm a famous negotiant! I trade things for other things - that's usually the way it goes. I sell short-supply goods and buy overstocked stuff.

Hmm. I admit, our name isn't habitual in Sarnaut... Alright, I'll tell you: our House lives on Ignis, Antoinette de Delice is our Great Mage. She gives us shelter and protection. Ignis is a curious allod: a country of eternal summer, with sandy beaches free from crowds of tourists, unlike the Summer Atoll. I remember, fifty years ago when Yasker and his soldier occupied Ignis, the Xadaganians only hanged out with the girls instead of fighting. Anyway, it's a bit on the tight and boring side. I'm trying to persuade Antoinette to open at least casinos, but she won't allow that. So I have to seek fun elsewhere.
Glory to you, my good friend. I'm glad to see you on Irene.

Gunter de Venar, at your service, my friend. I'm a famous racer. I raced on Kirah, on Ammer, but... I heard rumors that races might be organized here, on Irene. You understand, I couldn't miss the opportunity! What can be better than speed? Fresh wind in my face! Nothing. Tell me if you hear about the race, alright?

I came to the Great Ball like everyone else. Our family couldn't stay away! Especially since we represent the leaders of our House. While I'm here, my sister Gertrude controls Tenebra - she's Amanda de Desirae's mother. As for my daughter, Leticia - that insolent creature is traipsing around the woods on Umoir... If you run into each other, convey my indignation to her.
You don't need to bend the knee, there's no time for formalities.
Marguerite de Desirae, the governess of Tenebra allod and Prince Gaston's wife.

What an odd question! What does it look like? I'm celebrating the greatest event in our race's history. It's interesting to see representatives of the Empire here. Trust me, I've been to Igsh! At least I wasn't captured like many others. I, Volot Cursefist, and the League Sharpshooters had time to retreat, and then a landing ship picked us up. We spent some time in Nezebgrad during the war. It was nice. I hear things were different in the Empire!
I'm just a vogt in the League Army. It's not particularly glorious, but it's an officer rank, so I'm happy. I started as a taskmaster.

Recent years changed elves. Perhaps you've noticed that? The narrow-minded people of my House believe our good old magic is a solution, that it will rule the world... But look at other nations. What have they achieved? Many follow their example. Bullies are reaching for their blades, others dip their arrows in poison... But maybe future is about something different? About being one with nature? Druids... Animists... Shamans... We should learn from them. I hope some day elves will have their own forest guardians...

I used to be the head of the herbalist guild in Novograd, but then it merged with an alchemist guild... Pfft. As though alchemists know anything about herbs... Who knows the healing properties of plants better than us?

I came to visit the Great Ball and speak with the heads of the Houses. I have something to tell them. The world is changing, but it's as dangerous as ever. Our order was created for the purpose of battling demons. But there are other threats besides demons. And not every demon is willing to become your ally. They may no longer have their Creator, but they still pose a threat. They say there's the Council of Thirteen, the council of leaders of the largest packs... They are closely allied with fanatics, and they are ready to act.
I'm happy to see you again after so many years.
You forgot me already? I guess the amount of time you spend on the road makes it easy to forget things. I'm Pascal de Vevre, Commander of Demon Hunters.

We had a little poetry competition here with this charming Aoidos... Just think about it: we elves are the first of the races that appeared in this world... And the Aoidoi are the last of them. There is an abyss of epochs between us, but we are so alike!
Ah, it's wonderful here on Irene, it's a great place to fall in love and write poems...
You don't know me? That's strange. Selene's name is known to everyone who knows anything about beauty. And everyone is familiar with my poems.
I sell potions. Still, this is the welfare of our House, and we could use some money. Unfortunately, I don't have anything to sell right now. Just sold a large batch of aphrodisiacs.
Greetings, from the bottom of my heart!
I'm Charlotte de Blizare, a modest merchant from Novograd. I used to sell earrings, now I'm dealing in potions. Especially "secret potions", if you know what I mean.
I stand guard... in accordance with the ancient treaty... with the House de Grandeur...
I'm Yagaina! The queen of all Lamias, the ruler of our people...
Hello! Oh, why am I so bored in a place like this?
Right on time. We were going to have some wine. Can you bring us something... you know, something that goes best with wine?
I have no time! No time at all! Can you get me some frog leg soup?
Of course! I need something light and merry to drink. With bubbles, you know? Light and bubbly, yes.
It would be great if you could find me a bottle of Irene semi-sweet wine. My throat is dry, and I'm bored as hell.
I have nothing to tell you.

Oh, this is wonderful.

House de Delice is famous for its portal magic. We invented stationary portals to travel between allods. But now our House is staking on diplomacy. Our effort resulted in an agreement with vampires, which will be signed during the Great Ball. This isn't the only thing we could achieve. We're ready to resolve any conflicts and assist during negotiations with the Empire - and stop the war forever.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House. The widest range of underwear.

Our House servants are powerful werebears. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Lyr de Delice will join you. He's famous for his romantic victories and can win any heart!

And here's your cherry on top: we recently purchased a cheap batch of Matter of Creation, required to build a Guild allod. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

I'm happy to see you, ! Welcome to the Great House de Delice! I'm Antoinette de Delice, the head of the House and the Great Mage of the Ignis allod.

I'm glad you've come to me.

House de Vevre is famous for its love to fine arts and music. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music creation. Besides, we have excellent scouting skills. There is no secret that our oracles cannot reveal.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

Here's your cherry on top: we found a great number of ancient artifacts, known as Moon Dragon Armor. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

You did the right thing by coming here.

My House is famous for our knowledge of magic. We focus the practical rather than theoretical aspects of it. Our interests lie in the field of alchemy, the queen of magical sciences. There's no waving a magic wand and shouting incantations. Only a strong mind can comprehend it. Almost all popular recipes of elven potions are developed by the specialists of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

I'm glad to see you.

Our House is famous for the interest in magic. Magic is more than a craft for us. Magic is our whole life. Our House has the biggest number of magisters and acolytes. The main elven magic school is located on our home allod. The young mages begin their studies in a very young age. Apart from everything else, we shine in theoretical and practical magic.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are crafty lamias. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Grim de Grandeur will join you. He's a young mage with very unusual ideas. He'd like to test them, and you are going to help him.

Our magic allows us to create small amounts of Dust of Creation, a unique ingredient used for crafting of powerful artifacts. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

It's good that you're here.

The Great House de Pluie is natural in sales. Some say that we're too deep in business, banking, and other down to earth stuff, despised by many. There's beauty in it, believe me. Besides, House de Pluie is hosting the best artists, sculptors, and jewelers. Their works grant our superiority in the market.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are mighty minotaurs. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Ellia de Pluie will join you - a young entrepreneur, who can help you earn money on this allod.

We purchased a big batch of chests with various crafting materials you can choose from. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

Awesome! I salute you on behalf of House de Pluie!
